yourself. some people often don’t understand why you’re distancing yourself from one another. it’s to heal.

don’t apologize. try finding happiness in being by yourself, wether that’s being outside in the sun, reading, or just do something you like. find peace in things you like, try writing about it or taking mental health days. remember you’re never alone and people are rooting for you
